headline: Oilers place Devon Levi on injured reserve
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that the Oilers have placed goaltender Devon Levi on injured reserve and recalled Matt Tomkins from the AHL on an emergency basis. Oilersnation, posting for Daily Faceoff Edmonton, wrote that Levi is out "a few weeks."

The timing stings for a team sitting at 8-1-1 with 17 points. Levi has played seven games so far this season with a .886 save percentage and a goals saved above expected of -1.24, meaning he has let in about a goal and a quarter more than an average goalie would have on the same shots. That is a small sample, but it is not a problem the team will miss much. The bigger concern is that the crew in front of him has been carrying the goaltending. EDM as a team is at -4.7 goals saved above expected, and its 5-on-5 share of expected goals (the quality of chances taken versus allowed) is 49 percent, a hair below even. The record owes a lot to finishing: EDM has scored 15.1 goals more than its chances would predict.

For fantasy and betting purposes, that is the thing to watch. Edmonton has been winning on hot shooting while the goaltending has leaked, and a call-up in net does not make that easier.
